instruction: A candid outdoor photograph, eye-level full shot. On a wooden pier with a large suspension bridge under a cloudy sky, the bearded man in a white t-shirt and black leggings (R2) and the woman with a shaved head in a white crop top and gray shorts (R1) stand side-by-side. The bearded man (R2) balances on his right leg on a pink mat, holding his raised left foot with his left hand while raising his right arm straight up. The woman (R1) balances on her left leg on a beige mat, holding her raised right foot with her right hand while raising her left arm straight up. Both look forward calmly. Diffused daylight creates a soft, muted atmosphere.
